summary: Registers new customers in a CRM from a spreadsheet, duplicate-safe: a retried or crashed submission is reconciled by its operation reference, never repeated blindly. Duplicate e-mail addresses or phone numbers are reported, not re-created.
title: CRM customer registration
setup: Parameters: crmBaseUrl (the CRM origin), crmUser (the automation account). Secret: crmPassword. Requires the CRM to accept and search by an operation reference (idempotency key).
